regionalModel: Metropolitan French reference; regional variants require review

lessons.title: Hear a vowel change the form
lessons.objective: Distinguish /e/ and /ɛ/ in French words and verb forms while planning a walk.
lessons.focus: Compare pré /pʁe/ (meadow) with prêt /pʁɛ/ (ready), and parlé /paʁle/ (spoken) with parlais /paʁlɛ/ (I was speaking). Listen to the final vowel and use the sentence to recover the intended meaning.

words.fr: Je suis prêt pour la promenade.
Nous traversons le pré en été.
words.en: We cross the meadow in summer.

words.fr: J'ai parlé du trajet avec Léa.
words.en: I spoke about the route with Léa.

words.fr: Je parlais du sentier, pas du pré.
words.en: I was talking about the path, not the meadow.

reader.fr: En été, Marc prépare une promenade avec Léa.
reader.en: In summer, Marc plans a walk with Léa.

reader.fr: Il est prêt à traverser le pré derrière la maison.
reader.en: He is ready to cross the meadow behind the house.

reader.fr: Hier, il a parlé du trajet avec Léa.
reader.en: Yesterday, he spoke about the route with Léa.

reader.fr: Quand je parlais du sentier, Léa regardait la carte du pré.
reader.en: When I was talking about the path, Léa was looking at the map of the meadow.

speaking.scene: Clarifying a walking route near a meadow
speaking.opening: Bonjour, je suis prêt pour la promenade.
goals: Say when you cross the meadow.
Explain that you spoke with Léa about the route.
Clarify that you meant the path, not the meadow.
speaking.closure: Merci, nous sommes prêts à partir.

see.prompt: Locate /e/ and /ɛ/ in pré, prêt, parlé, and parlais, then match each form to its meaning.

recall.prompt: Recall the French sentence saying you are ready for the walk.
recall.answerRef: Je suis prêt pour la promenade.

hear.prompt: Listen for pré or prêt in the recorded walking phrase.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'We cross the meadow in summer.'
type.answerRef: Nous traversons le pré en été.

say.prompt: Clarify that you were talking about the path rather than the meadow.
say.answerRef: Je parlais du sentier, pas du pré.

write.prompt: Write two French sentences contrasting being ready with crossing the meadow and explaining what you discussed.

lessons.title: Join vowels with French glides
lessons.objective: Hear /j/, /ɥ/, and /w/ in common French words during a train exchange.
lessons.focus: Hear /j/ in hier and billet, /ɥ/ in huit and nuit, and /w/ in moi and trois. Move smoothly from the glide into the following vowel instead of giving the written vowel letters separate beats in these words.

words.fr: J'ai trois billets pour le train de nuit.
words.en: I have three tickets for the night train.

words.fr: Le train part à huit heures.
words.en: The train leaves at eight o'clock.

reader.fr: Hier, Ana a acheté trois billets pour le train de nuit.
reader.en: Yesterday, Ana bought three tickets for the night train.

reader.fr: Le train part à huit heures de la gare centrale.
reader.en: The train leaves the central station at eight o'clock.

reader.fr: Ana donne un billet à chacun de ses amis.
reader.en: Ana gives a ticket to each of her friends.

reader.fr: Son frère lui dit : « Et moi, je pars demain. »
reader.en: Her brother tells her, 'And I'm leaving tomorrow.'

speaking.scene: Checking night-train tickets at a station
speaking.opening: Bonjour, j'ai trois billets pour le train de nuit.
goals: Say when you bought the tickets.
Explain that another traveler leaves tomorrow.
speaking.closure: Merci, le train part bien à huit heures.

see.prompt: Group hier and billet under /j/, huit and nuit under /ɥ/, and moi and trois under /w/.

recall.prompt: Recall how many night-train tickets the traveler has.
recall.answerRef: J'ai trois billets pour le train de nuit.

hear.prompt: Listen for huit or nuit in the recorded train phrase.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'Yesterday, I bought the tickets.'

say.prompt: Tell the clerk when the train leaves.
say.answerRef: Le train part à huit heures.

write.prompt: Write two French sentences giving the ticket count and the departure time.

lessons.title: Keep adjacent vowels distinct
lessons.objective: Hear adjacent vowels in separate syllables in French words from a poetry-event exchange.
lessons.focus: In Noël, poète, poésie, théâtre, réunion, and aéroport, listen for neighboring vowel sounds across a syllable boundary. The tréma in Noël helps show that ë is pronounced separately; do not turn these sequences into the glides practiced in the previous lesson.

words.en: The poet arrives at the airport.

words.fr: La réunion a lieu au théâtre.
words.en: The meeting takes place at the theater.

words.fr: Nous lisons de la poésie à Noël.
J'attends le poète après la réunion.
words.en: I'm waiting for the poet after the meeting.

reader.fr: À Noël, le théâtre organise une soirée de poésie.
reader.en: At Christmas, the theater organizes a poetry evening.

reader.fr: Un poète arrive de l'aéroport pour lire ses textes.
reader.en: A poet arrives from the airport to read his work.

reader.fr: La réunion avec l'équipe du théâtre commence à dix heures.
reader.en: The meeting with the theater team starts at ten o'clock.

reader.fr: Après la réunion, le poète prépare sa lecture de Noël.
reader.en: After the meeting, the poet prepares his Christmas reading.

speaking.opening: Bonjour, la réunion a lieu au théâtre.
goals: Say when the poetry event takes place.
Explain when you will meet the poet.
speaking.closure: Merci, j'attends le poète après la réunion.

see.prompt: Find the neighboring written vowels that are spoken separately in Noël, poète, poésie, théâtre, réunion, and aéroport.

recall.prompt: Recall where the meeting takes place.
recall.answerRef: La réunion a lieu au théâtre.

hear.prompt: Listen for poète or poésie in the recorded event phrase.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'The poet arrives at the airport.'

say.prompt: Tell your colleague when you will wait for the poet.
say.answerRef: J'attends le poète après la réunion.

write.prompt: Write two French sentences placing the poet's arrival and the meeting at the theater.
